Elias climbed the lantern stairs as he had every morning for thirty years, polish in hand, expecting only wind, salt, and the familiar hush after rain. Near the tide line, however, he saw a bottle wedged in a crevice, its cork dark and swollen. He broke it carefully against the iron rail. Inside was a map, folded so often that its creases had turned soft as cloth. A single line was written on the back: The light knows the way home. Elias looked up at his beacon, then out at the empty horizon, and felt for the first time that he was not waiting for ships, but for someone already coming.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝色的睡意里。高楼窗中只剩几盏灯，像遗漏在海面的星。街道被雨洗过，路灯把湿光铺向远处。偶尔有出租车无声驶过，红色尾灯在路口一闪，便消失在高架的阴影中。便利店亮着暖黄招牌，咖啡机吐出轻微蒸汽声。风穿过楼宇，带着潮气与桂花甜意。海棠花静静开在街角，未眠的人守着一盏秘密的灯。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem uses a smaller version of itself to get closer to an answer.\n- You repeat that smaller step until you reach a simple stopping point, called the base case.\n- Then you bring each small answer back together to solve the original problem."}
